agent.description: Default Agent workflow for local data, factor discovery, computation, durable jobs and portable evidence; excludes platform writes and executable capability installation.

core.description: Compatibility baseline for dependency-thin reference runtimes. It includes the protocol-critical local data, factor, connector, benchmark and Evidence Pack tools.

full.description: Complete compatibility surface, including account-backed data, competition tools, executable pack management and legacy bridges. It is not recommended as the default Agent profile.

resources.name: Agent handshake
resources.description: Live local readiness, protocol versions, security boundary, and next actions.

resources.name: Quant research playbook
resources.description: Canonical local research workflow and separation of research from publication.

resources.name: Security contract
resources.description: Non-negotiable local execution, disclosure, and publication invariants.

resources.name: Selected local data
resources.description: Current local research panel binding without reading the panel contents.

resources.name: Causal operator catalogue
resources.description: Machine-readable causal operators accepted by Alpha Graph and local factor research.

prompts.name: quant_research
prompts.title: Start a local Alpha study
prompts.description: Bootstrap a reproducible local research session from a user goal.

arguments.name: goal
arguments.description: The user research objective, market, constraints, and desired deliverable.

prompts.name: quant_reproduce_alpha
prompts.title: Verify a reproducible Alpha
prompts.description: Verify an Evidence Pack and reproduce its canonical factor values locally.

arguments.name: artifact
arguments.description: Absolute path to the .qalpha Evidence Pack.

arguments.name: dataPath
arguments.description: Absolute local panel path when the original data is not already selected.

prompts.name: quant_private_evaluate
prompts.title: Evaluate at the data boundary
prompts.description: Run a private evaluation request without uploading data or source.

arguments.name: request
arguments.description: Absolute path to the private evaluation request.

arguments.name: artifact
arguments.description: Absolute path to the factor artifact or Evidence Pack.

arguments.name: dataPath
arguments.description: Absolute data path inside the custodian environment.

tools.name: quant_agent_handshake
tools.description: Read the complete local protocol, readiness, security boundary and next actions in one call.

tools.name: quant_agent_integrations
tools.description: Generate copy-ready stdio MCP profiles for Codex, Claude, Cursor, VS Code, OpenCode and generic MCP clients.

tools.name: quant_agent_manifest
tools.description: Discover stdio, local daemon and loopback MCP connection profiles.

tools.name: quant_alpha_graph
tools.description: Evaluate multiple named factors or an Alpha Graph DAG locally after loading the panel once, with adaptive CPU/CUDA diagnostics and an explicit backend trace.

tools.name: quant_app_info
tools.description: Discover this local client installation and runtime paths.

tools.name: quant_ashare_demo
tools.description: Run the same local Alpha evidence workflow on a caller-supplied normalized A-share panel.

tools.name: quant_auth_verify
tools.description: Verify the configured local Agent API token or desktop OAuth session against the identity provider without changing it.

tools.name: quant_backtest_run
tools.description: Run one catalog factor or local factor source through the canonical local backtest engine.

tools.name: quant_benchmark_evaluate
tools.description: Evaluate a graph or named factor locally under a public benchmark rule.

tools.name: quant_benchmark_inspect
tools.description: Read one public benchmark data, evaluation, artifact and privacy contract.

tools.name: quant_benchmark_leaderboard
tools.description: Verify signed evaluation receipts locally and reconstruct a benchmark ranking without a server.

tools.name: quant_benchmark_list
tools.description: List public benchmark rules. Listing does not evaluate or submit anything.

tools.name: quant_capabilities
tools.description: List the machine-readable client command surface.

tools.name: quant_capability_activate
tools.description: Consume one user-approved grant to activate a retained capability pack version without deleting the current version.

tools.name: quant_capability_install
tools.description: Consume one user-approved grant to validate and install a local capability package, retaining any previously installed versions.

tools.name: quant_capability_list
tools.description: List installed local Factor Packs and other capability packs without executing their code.

tools.name: quant_capability_remove
tools.description: Consume one user-approved grant to remove an installed capability pack version or all versions of a pack id.

tools.name: quant_capability_sign
tools.description: Sign a local qcap manifest with an Ed25519 publisher key.

tools.name: quant_competition_candidates
tools.description: List completed local backtest runs that can be submitted explicitly to the active competition.

tools.name: quant_competition_status
tools.description: Read the current identity competition task receipts without loading source.

tools.name: quant_competition_submit
tools.description: Consume one user-approved grant to submit a completed local run to the competition.

tools.name: quant_connector_join
tools.description: PIT as-of join two local qpanel tables by their availability time and write a reproducible joined dataset.

tools.name: quant_connector_list
tools.description: Discover local, warehouse and market-data connectors without returning credentials.

tools.name: quant_connector_pull
tools.description: Query one provider on this machine and write a normalized local research panel or a point-in-time qpanel/2 table.

tools.name: quant_crypto_demo
tools.description: Run the one-command public-data crypto Alpha demo locally and produce a signed reproducible artifact.

tools.name: quant_data_api_catalog
tools.description: List authenticated data APIs and field metadata available to this identity.

tools.name: quant_data_api_describe
tools.description: Read the field dictionary for one authenticated data API.

tools.name: quant_data_api_sample
tools.description: Read a bounded sample from one authenticated data API.

tools.name: quant_data_catalog
tools.description: Discover platform-published datasets, quality, coverage and queryability without downloading them.

tools.name: quant_data_export
tools.description: Export one explicitly confirmed authenticated data query to a local CSV or XLSX path.

tools.name: quant_data_freshness
tools.description: Read freshness diagnostics for platform-published local research data.

tools.name: quant_data_inspect
tools.description: Inspect a local CSV, Parquet, DuckDB or DB research panel.

tools.name: quant_data_query
tools.description: Run a bounded read-only query against one authenticated platform data API.

tools.name: quant_equity_demo
tools.description: Run the one-command public-data US equity Alpha demo locally with Yahoo daily bars.

tools.name: quant_evidence_audit
tools.description: Audit one factor for causal leakage, purged/embargoed holdout, costs, benchmark excess and observed order capacity.

tools.name: quant_evidence_index
tools.description: Discover, verify and group local .qalpha assets without uploading or executing them.

tools.name: quant_evidence_keygen
tools.description: Generate an Ed25519 private key for signing .qalpha Evidence Packs.

tools.name: quant_evidence_pack
tools.description: Create a portable .qalpha Evidence Pack and embed a complete local qalpha-audit/1 report when provided.

tools.name: quant_evidence_reproduce
tools.description: Re-run a graph/catalog Evidence Pack locally and compare canonical factor values.

tools.name: quant_evidence_verify
tools.description: Verify every digest in a .qalpha Evidence Pack.

tools.name: quant_factor_batch
tools.description: Evaluate an explicit local candidate list in one durable batch job.

tools.name: quant_factor_catalog
tools.description: Discover licensed open-source factor and operator sources.

tools.name: quant_factor_mine
tools.description: Mine built-in local factor candidates and return a durable job with candidate artifacts.

tools.name: quant_factor_names
tools.description: List factors runnable on the selected local panel with fields and output metadata.

tools.name: quant_factor_operators
tools.description: List the causal local operator catalogue.

tools.name: quant_factor_robustness
tools.description: Run a durable local OOS, cost, state and neutralization robustness diagnosis.

tools.name: quant_factor_screen
tools.description: Screen many named factors locally in chunks, rank diagnostics and reject highly correlated candidates.

tools.name: quant_family_audit
tools.description: Evaluate multiple local candidates on one data slice and seal aligned PBO/CSCV, Deflated Sharpe and multiple-testing evidence. This does not submit or publish anything.

tools.name: quant_job_status
tools.description: Read one local research job by id.

tools.name: quant_local_capabilities
tools.description: Read local CPU, CUDA, packages, capability packs, factors, operators and connector readiness without executing research.

tools.name: quant_local_data_select
tools.description: Select an explicit local CSV, Parquet, DuckDB or DB panel for this user. This changes local selection only and never uploads the file.

tools.name: quant_local_data_status
tools.description: Read the selected local research panel binding without loading its contents.

tools.name: quant_local_job_cancel
tools.description: Cancel one explicitly selected local research job.

tools.name: quant_local_job_result
tools.description: Read logs and artifact metadata for one completed local research job.

tools.name: quant_local_jobs_page
tools.description: Read a bounded page of local research jobs with active and queued counts. Use this instead of loading every historical job.

tools.name: quant_local_research_check
tools.description: Check a saved local factor project revision before starting a local run.

tools.name: quant_local_research_run
tools.description: Start an explicitly requested factor research run on this computer.

tools.name: quant_local_runtime_prepare
tools.description: Install or repair the local Python research runtime on this computer.

tools.name: quant_local_runtime_status
tools.description: Read whether the local Python research runtime is available.

tools.name: quant_market_snapshot
tools.description: Read the current authenticated market snapshot without writing files.

tools.name: quant_official_readiness
tools.description: Read official replay readiness and gate diagnostics for submitted work.

tools.name: quant_official_request
tools.description: Consume one user-approved grant to request a platform-operated, isolated official evaluation for an immutable local factor version and result artifact.

tools.name: quant_operation_grant_list
tools.description: List local operation grants without approving or consuming them.

tools.name: quant_operation_grant_request
tools.description: Create a pending one-time grant request for an external competition action. The user must approve it in the visible desktop client; this tool cannot approve itself.

tools.name: quant_operation_grant_status
tools.description: Read one local operation grant. PENDING means the user has not approved it; APPROVED allows one matching operation.

tools.name: quant_package_download
tools.description: Download one explicitly selected authorized data package to the local research data root.

tools.name: quant_packages_list
tools.description: List research data packages available to the current platform identity.

tools.name: quant_portfolio_local
tools.description: Optimize and replay an explicit local multi-factor portfolio as a durable job.

tools.name: quant_private_evaluation_receipt
tools.description: Sign a secure evaluator result receipt bound to the request, artifact and data commitments.

tools.name: quant_private_evaluation_request
tools.description: Create a local privacy-preserving evaluation request; it does not upload source or market data.

tools.name: quant_private_evaluation_run
tools.description: Run a requested factor evaluation against custodian-local data and sign an evaluator receipt.

tools.name: quant_private_evaluation_verify
tools.description: Verify a private evaluation receipt with a trusted evaluator public key.

tools.name: quant_private_runner
tools.description: Read the local compute-to-data runner isolation and privacy capabilities.

tools.name: quant_protocol_conformance
tools.description: Run the independent Quant Research Protocol suite; optionally execute a temporary synthetic Alpha Graph vector for semantic conformance.

tools.name: quant_public_leaderboard
tools.description: Read the public verified leaderboard with pagination and filters.

tools.name: quant_toolkit_manifest
tools.description: Read the installed local research toolkit manifest.
